title: From Generation to Detection: Exploration of Discourse Driven Scenario based LLM Generated Fake News
abstract: arXiv:2609.20838v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this study, we examine how modern LLMs generate and detect fake news under controlled settings across four manipulation scenarios. These are open-ended generation, rewriting, manipulation prompts and attribute based prompts grounded in the journalistic discourse framework. Firstly, using seven widely adapted models, we created a synthetic fake news corpus with 14000 generated articles across these four scenarios. Then we analyzed its linguistic properties to assess how closely model-generated news resembles real news structurally and semantically. Finally, to evaluate detection performance, we conducted experiments where each model judges generated fake news, starting with a basic detection prompt and improved prompts developed through an iterative refinement process that extracts misleading patterns from real-fake pairs. translated_title: 从生成到检测：基于话语驱动场景的大语言模型生成假新闻的探索
translated_abstract: 在本研究中，我们考察了现代大语言模型在受控环境下、跨四种操纵场景生成和检测假新闻的能力。这四种场景分别是开放式生成、改写、操纵提示词以及基于新闻话语框架的属性提示词。首先，我们使用七个广泛采用的模型，构建了一个包含14000篇生成文章的合成假新闻语料库，覆盖这四种场景。随后，我们分析了其语言特性，以评估模型生成的新闻在结构和语义上与真实新闻的相似程度。最后，为评估检测性能，我们开展了实验，让每个模型对生成的假新闻进行判断，从基础检测提示词开始，并通过迭代优化过程（从真假新闻对中提取误导性模式）不断改进提示词。我们的结果显示，各模型在生成和检测虚假信息方面均存在显著差异。
tldr: 本研究基于新闻话语框架构建了包含14000篇文章的合成假新闻语料库，系统考察了七种大语言模型在四种场景下生成与检测假新闻的能力，发现不同模型在生成和检测虚假信息方面表现差异显著。
en_tdlr: This study builds a synthetic fake news corpus of 14,000 articles grounded in the journalistic discourse framework to systematically examine how seven LLMs generate and detect fake news across four scenarios, revealing substantial variation in both generation and detection performance across models.
